mean_cn: v.混合，联合；（使）结合；  n.联合收割机（读作/ˈkɑmˌbaɪn/）；联合体，联合企业
mean_en: to come together in order to work or act together; to put two things or groups together so that they work or act together
sentence: Combine yellow and blue, and you will get green.
sentence_trans: 把黄色和蓝色混合起来，你就会得到绿色。
word_etyma: com与...一起 + bin成对地 + e → combine联合
